description: Ministry of Public Administration, Home Affairs Provincial Council & Local Government - The Regulation of Sri Paramananda Vihara Esala Perehara of Kotahena Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Pilgrimages Ordinance, establishing legal frameworks and compliance requirements for pilgrimage activities. It outlines regulatory procedures, powers of government officials, and legal obligations for pilgrims, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which cover "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation."
